$comment: RFC-0034. The catalogue index: pack display order and the outcome browse axis (RFC-0026). Pack metadata lives in packs/<pack>/pack.json; membership is the folders — a skill is in a pack because it sits at packs/<pack>/skills/<name>/.

decide-what-to-build.description: Turn a direction into a committed, measurable plan: press releases, strategy frameworks, OKRs, business cases, requirements, PRDs, and the metrics that will say whether it worked.

design-the-system.description: Commit the shape before the code: decision records, design docs, diagrams, contracts, schemas, migration and threat models, and the design of any agentic parts.

build-and-review-software.description: The loop around the code itself: supervised implementation, adversarial review panels, test plans, triage, accessibility and static-analysis passes, and the policy files agents read.

build-on-the-claude-api.for: Teams building on the Anthropic API
build-on-the-claude-api.description: Skills for teams building directly on the Anthropic API — prompt caching strategy, token budgeting, eval generation, and tool-use schema writing.

run-and-recover-the-service.description: Operate what shipped: runbooks, observability design, release notes, incident communication, and the postmortem that closes the loop.

explain-it-to-decision-makers.description: Get a non-technical audience to a decision: audience profiling, deck outlines and real decks, exec summaries, decision logs, and how-to guides.

govern-ai-use.for: AI enablement · engineering leaders · risk owners
govern-ai-use.description: Adopt AI deliberately and prove what it is doing: readiness assessment, use-case triage, rollout plans, acceptable-use policy, adoption staging, and usage reporting.

create-on-brand-collateral.for: Marketers · designers · anyone making a deck or flyer
create-on-brand-collateral.description: Make collateral that looks like it came from your team: capture the brand once, then build decks and print-ready flyers with your logo, colours and fonts.

get-a-draft-ready-to-ship.description: The passes either side of a generator: collect a messy input into a structured brief, critique the argument, and strip the machine artifacts before it leaves the building.

design-the-experience.description: Shape what people see and read before it's built: information architecture, interface copy, content specs, component specs and service blueprints.

research-a-question.for: Researchers · analysts · anyone with a question to answer
research-a-question.description: Take a question to a sourced answer: a research plan with a stopping rule, a cited synthesis of the sources, and competing explanations weighed against the evidence.

define-and-trust-the-numbers.description: Make the numbers a business runs on mean one thing: metric definitions a semantic layer can implement, SQL reviewed for wrong answers, and dashboards specced before they're built.

manage-risk-and-compliance.description: Prepare the material compliance asks for: a data protection impact assessment, a SOC 2 evidence map, and a risk register with owners and review dates.

build-agent-skills.for: Anyone writing skills for an AI agent
build-agent-skills.description: Write and review Agent Skills for any tool: a portable SKILL.md with evals, and an audit of an existing skill before it ships.
